relations.note: Often treated as the same forest being, though some traditions distinguish them.
relations.source: Regan, Hacia la tierra sin mal

relations.note: Regan presents Sacharuna as an equivalent forest-person or forest-owner category.
relations.source: Regan, Hacia la tierra sin mal

relations.note: The game-raising forest owner is called supay or shapingo at Alto Pucalpillo.
Lexicographic sources directly translate Shapshico or Shapingo as the Christian Devil.
Shapshico can situationally name a medicinal plant’s animate owner, guardian, or teacher.
Loreto and Ucayali sources use these names for comparable or identical forest devils.
